statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH because verified futures are firmer and live no-retracement NQ structure is unverified; rates and Middle East escalation keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; the next concentrated checkpoint is the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and subsequent cash-open price discovery.
headline: Firmer futures keep Tail low while rates and geopolitics sustain extreme Stress
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq futures up 0.6%, firm short Treasury yields, a seven-week-high dollar and easing oil despite fresh Middle East escalation. The Fed raised its target range to 3.75%-4.00%. Live NQ failed-retracement structure is not independently verified.
